notes.title: Dev Blog - Building system
notes.content:
[h3]Hi Everyone ![/h3]

Here again a small progress-update about Rokatusch.
[b]Notice:[/b] Since the workers are controlled by AI (Artificial intelligence), there are some delays between the actions (Running, cutting trees and building buildings), so that the whole thing also works performers.

[h2]What's going on?[/h2]
The building system is as good as you can see in the video on the edge.
System: You place a game-pre-defined blueprint somewhere and order that building. You are able to build up this building after that or send workers.

[previewyoutube=Mjo-YhfFpxg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What's next?[/h2]
I will continue with AI logic (Spawn more workers, build village, ...).

Otherwise nice day and greetings
NoserverStudios
